Each of these different elements plays its own direct role when the moving vehicle finally impacts the standing barrier.

theories.paragraph: A person leaps from a boat towards a platform, trying to land safely across the water. Whether the person reaches the dock is determined by how hard the leaping person pushes off and how high up the leaping person starts. These two conditions work together at the moment of the jump to shape where the trajectory ends up, deciding if the jump succeeds in reaching the destination.
